name: Geth
description: A Phyrexian who assaults Venser at the shrine to Karn.

description_citations.text: "Venser". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geth speaks of conquest and pawns.
timeline.quote: In the game of conquest, who cares about the pawns if the king yet reigns?

citation.text: Barter in Blood (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geth urges mastery of the mists.
timeline.quote: Feel the burn of the mists. Master them. They will devour your enemies.

citation.text: Devour in Shadow (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mayvar threatens to claim a victim's blood, marrow and spirit.
timeline.quote: Your blood, your marrow, your spirit—all are mine.

citation.text: Consume Spirit (Ninth Edition, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Atraxa orders Ixhel to seek out and kill the traitor Geth, a Steel Thane of the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: I want you to seek him out, Ixhel. I want you to end him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel pins a stammering aspirant who says he is Belaxis and has a contract with Lord Geth, whom he calls the Thane of Contracts.
timeline.quote: Lord Geth makes deals. That's why they call him the Thane of Contracts!

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Geth ambushes Ixhel, whom he mocks as a foot soldier, and speaks of loyalty that can be bought.
timeline.quote: The only true loyalty is that which can be bought.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Geth asks what Ixhel will have beyond her orthodoxy and the love of her mother, and chokes her.
timeline.quote: What about you, little emissary?

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel opens her own throat on Geth's blade to break free and beheads him.
timeline.quote: you bring down your blade in a single stroke, parting his head from his body.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel decides to help Geth's head and carries it to the Dominus of Pain.
timeline.quote: Maybe, in this, you can help him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Bruenna is captured by Yert in the Mephidross and hooked into a stasis machine; Glissa frees her but is locked in stasis for five years.
timeline.quote: There she was captured by Yert

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa slaughters Yert's Reaper and wins his help; Geth's vampire attacks her and she defeats it, forcing Geth to tell her what she wanted.
timeline.quote: Geth told Glissa what she wanted to know which got her to leave more quickly

citation.text: "Geth", section "The Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yert is fed to the vampire, rises as a vampire and beheads Geth, who survives as a lich-head.
timeline.quote: he overthrew Geth after beheading him

citation.text: "Geth", section "The Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Karn's return, Geth becomes a guardian of the Mirari on a Memnite.
timeline.quote: Geth became one of the guardians of the Mirari

citation.text: "Geth", section "The Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During Phyrexian corrosion, Geth takes a Phyrexian body and wipes out contenders to reclaim the Vault of Whispers.
timeline.quote: he wiped out contenders to the Vault of Whispers

citation.text: "Geth", section "Scars of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geth makes protective contracts with flawed aspirants; Atraxa sends Ixhel, who decapitates him.
timeline.quote: Ixhel decapitated him

citation.text: "Geth", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixhel kills Belaxis and builds Vishgraz from his and Geth's parts.
timeline.quote: used parts from his and Geth's bodies

citation.text: "Geth", section "Vishgraz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa befriends Kha Raksha at Taj-Nar and travels through the Mephidross with Slobad and Bosh, defeating Geth.
timeline.quote: After defeating him, she struck a deal to spare him for information

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn leaves Glissa, Slobad and Geth as the new guardians of Mirrodin and the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Karn left Glissa, Slobad, and Geth as the new guardians of Argentum (Mirrodin) and the Mirari .

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn restores the souls, causing the Vanishing, destroys Memnarch's body and gives the Mirari to Glissa, Slobad and Geth.
timeline.quote: Karn destroyed Memnarch's body, recovering the Mirari

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Memnarch's defeat Karn melts him down, revealing the Mirari, left in the care of Glissa, Slobad and Geth.
timeline.quote: Karn returned to his plane and melted down Memnarch to his core, revealing the Mirari underneath.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geth is compleated into Vishgraz by Ixhel.
timeline.quote: he was compleated fully into Vishgraz by Ixhel

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Seven Steel Thanes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask starts a rebellion against Norn.
timeline.quote: Urabrask started a rebellion against Norn's Phyrexia.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Conquering the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geth is assassinated and Sheoldred executed before the invasion.
timeline.quote: with Geth assassinated and Sheoldred executed long before the bulk of the invasion

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Conquering the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geth reports to Glissa and the mad Karn, and Glissa sends Tezzeret to bring Elspeth to her.
timeline.quote: Karn has gone mad and keeps dripping glistening oil

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group defeats the necromancer Geth at Ish Sah.
timeline.quote: ruled by the necromancer Geth

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa's group reaches Geth's throne room in the Vault of Whispers, where Geth welcomes them menacingly and springs a trap.
timeline.quote: Once inside, Geth enters and welcomes them menacingly.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "The Vault of Whispers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raksha's leonin ambush Vektro's goblin party and Geth's severed head delivers Yert's demand for Glissa.
timeline.quote: His animate head delivers a message from Yert

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "Geth's head". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa reappears after five years, learning Taj-Nar is lost and the Mephidross has spread.
timeline.quote: Bruenna solemnly informs her that she's been missing for five years

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "Five years Later". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa confronts Geth, severs his vampire's arm, and takes his serum.
timeline.quote: Glissa takes his serum but leaves Yert behind

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "The Mephidross and finding Bosh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geth creates a new vampire from Yert after Glissa defeats his bodyguard.
timeline.quote: Geth created a new vampire from a Moriok named Yert

citation.text: "Vampire", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser teleports into the Black Lacuna, finds a shrine to Karn, is attacked by Geth, and sees the Phyrexian army invade the surface.
timeline.quote: At this shrine, he was assaulted by Geth and was forced to flee back to the surface

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
Consume Spirit (Ninth Edition, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

relations.note: Belaxis guards Geth's gate by contract.
relations.quote: And now I guard the gate to his holdings.

citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.
